w: The last day of Swamishri’s stay in Nairobi. During Swamishri’s 82-day tour of Africa he sanctified 10 countries: S. Africa, Botswana, Zambia, Zimbabwe, Malawi, Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Egypt and Israel. Swamishri inaugurated new mandirs in Nairobi, Durban and Nakuru and re-established new murtis at the mandirs in Dar-es-Salaam, Kampala and Jinja. Land for new mandirs were acquired at Kisumu (Kenya) and Gaberon (Botswana). Swamishri departed from Nairobi on Kenya Airways at 8.25 p.m.

At 10.10 am Swamishri blessed and flagged off a Walk-a-thon. Annually the Walk-a-thon is held at all the Satsang centers in America to promote family health and harmony. Today under the auspices of the Haveli Mahotsav, more than 700 devotees were ready to chant the Swaminarayan dhun and walk a distance of 4.5 miles. Swamishri too joined the walkathon for a short round, circumambulating the Haveli, and then saw the Haveli construction in detail.

In the evening assembly the Kishore Din theme was 'Thank You'. The Kishores conducting the program spoke on the glory of God's creation. The presentation was interspersed with projections of natural scenes of earth, water, fire, air and space. This was followed by a folk dance and drama presentation. Swamishri blessed the assembly and finally the kishores and kishoris honored Lord Harikrishna Maharaj.

2002.o: Sharad Purnima, 218th Birthday Celebration of Gunatitanand Swami
w: After his morning puja , Swamishri joined in the mahapuja and prayed for the Narmada waters to reach all parts of Gujarat, the successful completion of Akshardham in New Delhi and mandir projects in India and abroad.

At 8.45 p.m., the Sharad Purnima festival commenced. The speeches on the glory of Gunatitanand Swami were interlaced with brief dramas, arti and traditional dances. Finally, Swamishri blessed the assembly and performed the final arti.

In the evening satsang assembly, the kishores presented a drama entitled ‘Sant-samagam’. Blessing the assembly afterwards, Swamishri said, “In this age of materialism, people earn money but do not preserve the wealth in their homes. If one’s spiritual wealth, dharma, values and traditions are preserved then virtues remain and radiate fragrance. If there is a mandir in the home, a daily family assembly takes place, family members sit together to listen to each other with affection and amicably solve any problems, then love for each other will increase. If parents sit with children, they will sit with them and traditional values will be strengthened. Such a home provides inspiration.” India’s Deputy High Commissioner, Purushottam Das, had come to receive Swamishri’s blessings.

Guests: H.H. Shri Vishveshtirthji, Head of Pejavar Math, opined, “I am very happy and wonderstruck after seeing Akshardham. I experienced that I was not in this world. You have created Indralok in Indraprastha. It is a place of pride for all Indians. It is a beacon of gnan and bhakti for the life-boats sailing in this ocean of life. “I am astonished by the film on Bhagwan Swaminarayan (large format film). I am inspired. The life and message of Swaminarayan is a source of guidance for the whole world.

Akshardham is a grand mandir of our culture that spreads devotion, love and spirituality. In the Bhagvad Gita Arjun regains his memory and becomes free of disillusion (moha) by the cosmic darshan of Bhagwan Shri Krishna. Similarly, this mandir where one has the darshan of the cosmic form of our culture, will destroy the disillusionment. For all youths Akshardham will become a place of enlightenment. ”

st.t: Diwali Celebrations 2006 at BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, London
w: In the presence of Pramukh Swami Maharaj, the Diwali festival was celebrated with great enthusiasm at BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, London on Saturday 21 October 2006. Swamishri arrived at the Mandir for his morning darshan of the murtis lit with lamps, and then proceeded to the Haveli for pooja.

Following the pooja darshan, Swamishri expressed his wish to offer his blessings on this auspicious occasion. Swamishri talked of removing the darkness of ignorance in our lives and becoming permanently enlightened with the gnan of Atma & Parmatma through the association of the Gunatit Satpurush.

Throughout the morning and afternoon streams of devotees and visitors arrived beholding the majestic murtis adorned with rich clothes and ornaments. Following the Sandhya Arti at 6:30 p.m., the sadhus commenced the Chopda Poojan ceremony, where business owners close their accounts and open new accounts on this auspicious day. Hundreds of new account books were sanctified by Pramukh Swami Maharaj with the showering of flower petals and rice grains, amidst the chanting of vedic hymns and prayers to Bhagwan Swaminarayan.

A short evening sabha was held following the Chopda Poojan ceremony in which Viveksagar Swami explained the significance of the festival. In his blessings, Swamishri spoke of the importance of devotion to God who has provided us with the wealth. Swamishri also emphasised that inner peace cannot be attained through mere materialistic possessions but only through Satsang.

Diwali is the ‘festival of lights’ and a fitting exhibition of this festival was provided with a grand fireworks display that lit the skies of North London with a thirty-minute performance. Countless spectators, including local residents and passers-by were awestruck by the light and beauty of Indian culture with a crescendo of sound and colour providing a fitting climax. As the crowds dispersed, the preparations for the following day’s Annakut programme began in earnest.

Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of pujan and arti for the BAPS hari mandirs in Kandivali (Mumbai) and Goregaon (Mumbai), shila pujan of shikharbaddh mandir for Nagpur, foundation-stone ceremony for the hari mandir in Malad and a student hostel in Kharghar. The main ceremony today was the foundation-stone laying ceremony of ‘Pramukh Sadan’, a residential and utility centre, to be built on the mandir complex. The next morning Swamishri departed for Gondal. The flight landed at Rajkot airport. Kothari Yogiswarup Swami and other sadhus welcomed Swamishri with garlands. Thereafter Swamishri headed by car towards Gondal. While passing through the streets of Rajkot devotees honoured Swamishri by showering rice grains and flowers and igniting fire crackers. On arriving in Gondal the students of BAPS Gurukul showered flower petals on Swamishri’s car. Devotees proclaimed jais and bowed humbly as Swamishri’s car entered through Akshar Dwar into the mandir precincts. Kothari Gnanprasad Swami welcomed Swamishri with a garland.
30 devotees pilgrimaged on foot from Vikroli to the mandir.
Today, after his evening meal, Mahant Swami Maharaj came for a special programme, the "Ruchi Quiz" (preferences quiz). From the questions asked of him, his natural preferences
and opinions emerged as follows.
(1) Which flower do you like making a garland of?
Answer: Mogra (jasmine) flowers.
(2) Which dish do you like serving?
Answer: Puranpoli.
(3) On which work of Shriji Maharaj do you especially like to reflect?
Answer: His travels through the forests.
(4) On the life of which paramhansa would you like to give a parayan (series of discourses)?
Answer: Muktanand Swami.
"Why?"
"His saintliness," Swamishri said at once.
(5) Which work or which virtue in the life of Gunatitanand Swami touches you?
Answer: His closeness with devotees.
(6) On which work of Shastriji Maharaj do you especially like to reflect?
Answer: That he gave us the gift of Yogiji Maharaj and Pramukh Swami Maharaj.
(7) Which virtue in the life of Yogiji Maharaj touched you the most?
Answer: Tolerance.
(8) Which incident of Yogiji Maharaj do you especially like to reflect on?
Answer: When he saw a virtue in those who were playing cards.
"Why?"
"There was no room at all for seeing a virtue, and yet he saw one!"
(9) You and Pramukh Swami Maharaj are really one, but in worldly terms, what is the relationship between you and Pramukh Swami Maharaj?
Answer: Devotee and God.
(10) Which benefit of the Satpurush would you choose to take?
Answer: Listening to his talks.
"Which talks?"
"On a sense of divinity, friendliness, and not having negative feelings or
seeing faults."
(11) Which virtue of Pramukh Swami Maharaj do you especially like?
Answer: Humility.
(12) Which seva do you especially like to do?
Answer: Scrubbing utensils.
(13) Which thought do you most like to think?
Answer: Of his pleasure.
"Why?"
"Shriji Maharaj has said in Vachanamrut Gadhada II 28 that the principle of all the scriptures is to do whatever pleases God. Everything is contained in that."
(14) To whom do you immediately feel like giving prasad?
Answer: To one who does special austerities.
(15) Which means is most important for the growth of satsang?
Answer: Conduct.
(16) In your free time, what do you like to engage your mind in?
Answer: Reading.
(17) When devotees come to you with worldly problems, what is your first thought?
Answer: Compassion.
(18) When government or official problems of a mandir come up, what is your very first thought?
Answer: Prayer, and that whatever Maharaj does is for the good.
(19) Which season suits you best?
Answer: All of them (suit me).
(20) What is your favourite subject?
Answer: Science.
(21) Which trait do you dislike?
Answer: Ego.
(22) What colour garments do you feel like dressing Thakorji in?
Answer: Purple.
(23) Which is your favourite Vachanamrut?
Answer: The fifth of the last section (Gadhada III 5). Yogibapa told me, "Gadhada III 5 suits your nature."
(24) Which is your favourite kirtan?
Answer: "Swamiji to Mahapratapi..."

ds.t: Does our mental worship reach you?
ds.p: On the flight from London to Delhi
w: Today Rajdeepbhai of Tampa asked Mahant Swami Maharaj a question: "Does the mansi (mental worship) we do reach you?"
Swamishri smiled and said "Yes".
Rajdeepbhai asked, "But how can we know?"
"A pure feeling..." Swamishri said. That is, "Whatever you do with a pure feeling reaches me."

Then he also wrote a beautiful blessing: "There is no question at all of small or big financial or mental seva, but if the heart is pure, Maharaj, Swami and Pramukh Swami Maharaj accept everything. Like the 13 dokdas (coins) of Dubli Bhatt.
S.K. (Sadhu Keshavjivandas)
In Air from London to Delhi
(In the air, travelling from London to Delhi)
21 October 2017"

ds.t: The blessing he wishes to give
ds.p: On the flight from London to Delhi
w: Gnanvardhandas Swami requested Mahant Swami Maharaj, "Every time we ask for different blessings, but today please give whatever blessing you wish."
Swamishri said, "Keep a sense of divinity towards everyone."

ds.p: On the flight from London to Delhi
w: Jerry Palmer, a senior pilot who was deeply moved by Mahant Swami Maharaj, came to him. Holding Swamishri's hands, he began to say in a voice full of feeling, "I pray that I may serve as a servant. My priest and the nuns also know that I am meeting you. They all pray for you too."
Swamishri gave him a mala as a gift and asked him to do 1 mala. Accepting it gladly, Shri Jerry said, "Thank you very, very much."
"He awakens love for the feet of the Lord and removes great delusion... In the world, the Sant is the supreme benefactor."
Swamishri is such a supreme benefactor Sant.
